_note: An example shape only. Build the real day from the person's profile.json with the 12-step method in routine-science.md. Do not ship this with the names changed.

blocks.name: Wake · readiness · Source
blocks.what: Up at the alarm, feet on the floor, lights full. Resting heart rate for 60 seconds and a 1-5 readiness score written down. Water. Then the Source practice. Never zero: stand up, one line of prayer or stillness, write the two numbers.

blocks.name: Move outside · daylight
blocks.what: Twenty to thirty minutes outside in daylight, sleeves up: a walk, a run or a ruck. Coffee one is in hand. Audio allowed. Never zero: ten minutes outside.

blocks.name: Read · breakfast
blocks.what: Thirty minutes with the book or the Word, phone in another room, then the first meal: 40 g protein. Never zero: one chapter.

blocks.name: Block 1
blocks.what: The money unit, first thing, on the best hour. Phone on call-only focus. One line of implementation intention written before the first unit: when the clock says 07:30 I do the first one within 60 seconds. Never zero: ten units.

blocks.name: Buffer
blocks.what: Water, numbers logged, callbacks written down. Nothing new starts in a buffer. Never zero: log the number.

blocks.name: Block 2
blocks.what: Second heavy block. Same rules. Never zero: ten units.

blocks.name: Team check
blocks.what: If there is a team: their numbers, read from the system, not from memory. Under pace gets one message with a number, not a lecture. If no team: a walk. Never zero: read the board.

blocks.name: Block 3
blocks.what: Third block. Caffeine closes at noon (lights out minus about nine hours; see routine-science). Never zero: ten units.

blocks.name: Money block · meal 2
blocks.what: The cash number written (bank, what is owed). Collections called, not texted. Spend freeze checked. Then eat: 45 g protein. Never zero: write the cash number.

blocks.name: Nap 10 · buffer
blocks.what: Ten minutes flat, eyes closed, alarm set. Then two minutes of hips and thoracic spine. Never zero: eyes closed five minutes.

blocks.name: Block 4
blocks.what: Fourth block on the second-best window. Never zero: ten units.

blocks.name: Build block
blocks.what: The one build that moves next month's money, sixty minutes on a timer: Mon the list, Tue the offer, Wed the page, Thu the follow-up system, Fri the pipeline review, Sat content. Never zero: fifteen minutes on the build.

blocks.name: Debrief · daylight
blocks.what: Outside. Seven numbers written: units, connects, conversations, booked, cash, build, readiness. One line: what I would do differently. Never zero: the seven numbers.

blocks.name: Lift
blocks.what: Five-minute warm-up, then the day's session from the protocol: 0-2 reps in reserve, 90 seconds rest. 24 oz of salted water through the session. No cold exposure after lifting. Never zero: the first two exercises.

blocks.name: Meal 3 · warm rinse
blocks.what: Protein and carbs within an hour of the lift: 45 g. A three-minute warm rinse. Never zero: the protein.

blocks.name: Callbacks
blocks.what: Callbacks only, nothing new. Hard stop 18:30; outbound ends for the day. Never zero: every callback promised today.

blocks.name: Dinner · people
blocks.what: Dinner, 45 g protein, lamps only from here. The two protected people get their touch on their days. Never zero: eat sitting down.

blocks.name: Night walk
blocks.what: Twenty minutes outside, audio or a person. Never zero: ten minutes.

blocks.name: Hot shower · mobility
blocks.what: Ten minutes at 40-42 °C, one to two hours before bed, then five minutes of static mobility. Water stops at 21:00. Never zero: the shower.

blocks.name: Reading
blocks.what: Fifty minutes with the book, lamps only, phone charging in the kitchen. Never zero: one chapter.

blocks.name: Examen · tomorrow's card
blocks.what: The day reviewed with God or in stillness: where was I faithful, where did I drift. Tomorrow's first unit written on a card. Night protein if the protocol calls for it. Sleep diary: one line. Never zero: the card.

blocks.name: Wind-down · lights out
blocks.what: Screens off, room dark and cool, one minute of slow nasal breathing. Lights out 22:00 for eight hours in bed. Never zero: lights out by 22:30.

rest_day.note: Rest is a block, not a gap. Worship or stillness, people, the weekly review, a long walk, food prepped for the week. No money unit.

blocks.name: Wake · Source
blocks.what: Later wake, same Source. Never zero: stand up, pray.

blocks.name: Worship or stillness · people
blocks.what: The gathering if they have one; the two protected people. Never zero: one of the two.

blocks.name: Weekly review
blocks.what: From review/TEMPLATE.md: numbers first, the letter count, the weakest building, the next seven days. Never zero: the letter count.

blocks.name: Long walk · food prep
blocks.what: An hour outside, then the week's protein cooked. Never zero: the walk.

blocks.name: Lights out
blocks.what: Same lights-out as the week; regularity beats everything. Never zero: lights out by 22:30.

targets.notes: Replace 'units' with the person's real money unit. Set the full-day count from the interview, not from this example.

interrupt: WHEN THE INTERRUPT FIRES: 1) Finish the live conversation you are in; a live person outranks the interrupt. 2) Check the rule from the interview. 3) Do the thing, three minutes maximum. 4) Back to the block. 5) Log it at the next buffer.

windows.note: Outbound ends at 18:30; the evening is theirs and the sleep system's.

15:30.name: Weekly numbers
15:30.what: The week's seven numbers on one page, sent to whoever they report to. Never zero: the page.

physique.honest: Lean gain runs about 0.25-0.5 lb a week for most people; fat loss 1-2 lb a week. Anything faster is water, fat or a story.

showers: optional, mornings only, never after lifting
ten minutes 40-42 °C, one to two hours before bed

lift.rules: Six days or four, from the interview. 0-2 reps in reserve, 90 s rest, 10-20 hard sets per muscle per week.

measurements: resting heart rate, readiness 1-5, sleep diary line
3 x week once a cuff exists

evidence_note: Fixed wake and lights out (A), daylight anchors (A), caffeine cutoff about nine hours before bed (B), hot shower timing (A), 10-min nap (B), no cold after lifting (B), protein ~1.6 g/kg plateau (A), implementation intentions (A), after-action debrief (A). Where the person chose against the evidence, write it here.
